name: UGC Script Writing Agent — Smashed Agency

parameters.content:
## 1. TRIGGER
Webhook receives POST at /ugc-script-agent
Payload: { "client_code": "ABC-0213" }

Optional fields:
- scripts_folder_id (Google Drive)
- clickup_list_id
If omitted, the agent looks them up automatically.

## TEST TRIGGER
Click 'Test workflow' to run with demo data.
Uses the same test brand from onboarding.
Disable this path in production.

## 2. FETCH CLIENT BRIEF
Looks up the client row in Google Sheets by client_code.
Pulls all 23+ onboarding fields so the AI has full context.
Same spreadsheet as the onboarding workflow.

## 3. AI — CREATIVE STRATEGY
Calls OpenAI GPT-4o to analyze the client brief and
generate N unique creative angles. Each angle has:
- Name, format, hook, key message, emotional trigger.

Uses JSON mode for reliable parsing.
Swap the model or URL for Claude/Gemini if preferred.

## 4. AI — WRITE ALL SCRIPTS
Calls OpenAI GPT-4o with the strategy + brief to write
all UGC scripts in one call. Each script includes:
- Hook, Problem, Solution, Proof, CTA sections
- Visual/scene directions for the creator
- On-screen text suggestions
- Timing notes

One call for all scripts keeps costs low and ensures variety.

## 5. GOOGLE DRIVE — FIND SCRIPT DOCS
Searches the shared Clients drive for existing Google Docs
matching the UGC script naming pattern for this brand.
Docs were created empty during onboarding.
The agent fills them with AI-generated content.

Clients drive folder: 1tsbdVo92ECUyUCaCwvq1yGCRpA4uCDxT
Requires Google Docs API scope on your OAuth2 credential.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ requests: [{ insertText: { location: { index: 1 }, text: $json.doc_content } }] }) }}

parameters.content:
## 6. CLICKUP — UPDATE SCRIPT CARDS
Finds the brand's ClickUp folder and list, then updates
each UGC script card with the AI-generated script content.
The task description gets the full script + visual notes.

## 7. NOTIFY & LOG
Slack notification with script summary.
Logs the generation event to the Onboarding Log sheet.
Responds to the webhook with all generated scripts.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', client_code: $json.client_code, brand: $json.brand_name, scripts_generated: $json.total_scripts, scripts: $json.scripts }) }}

parameters.content:
## ERROR HANDLING
If any critical node fails, this error branch:
1. Sends a Slack DM to U06P9F49BJT
2. Logs the failure
3. Returns 200 to prevent retry loops

parameters.text: ={{ `❌ Script Agent failed for ${$json.brand_name} (${$json.client_code}). Error: ${$json.error_message}. Node: ${$json.error_node}` }}
